SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.

REPORT

S.4. Cr. & Sp. br. File No. Date February 26, 1943.

SUBJECT: Re the attached Registration of
"Photo News"

Re the attached Registration Certificate no. F.
165 issued to Mr. Fischer on the 6th of July 1942,
the undersigned beg. to report that this Certificate
is invalid as the Magazine was taken over by Mr.
Awald and a new Certificate was issued to him on the
29-12-42. But this Certificate was later withdrawn
by the Authorities on the 20-1-43 as the publication
of this Magazine was not permitted. The old one had
however not been withdrawn.

The said Certificate No. F. 165 is therefore
kindly submitted for cancellation.

(18.2.43)
D.S. 68

Officer i/c Section 4.

D.C. (Crime & Special Branch).

报告

S.4. 刑事与特别支部。档案编号。日期：1943年2月26日。

事由：关于所附“Photo News”（《摄影新闻》）的注册事宜

关于1942年7月6日签发给Fischer先生的所附第F.165号注册证书，谨此报告，该证书已失效，因为该杂志已由Awald先生接管，并于1942年12月29日向其签发了新证书。但该证书后于1943年1月20日被当局撤销，因为该杂志的出版未获许可。然而，旧证书并未被撤销。

因此，恳请将上述第F.165号证书予以注销。

(1943年2月18日)
D.S. 68

第四科主管警官。

副督察长（刑事与特别支部）。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.

Registration Certificate.
Magazines and Newspapers
Municipal Notification No. 4878 of October 21, 1937.

PHOTO NEWS (WAR PICTURES)

has been registered on JULY 6, 1942.

and this certificate of registration No. F. 165 is issued accordingly to
I. H. FISCHER, the registered Editor.
（印：...）
S. Got. D.C.
for Commissioner of Police.
（印：...）

This certificate is issued solely to the registered editor in respect of the
publication of PHOTO NEWS (WAR PICTURES) AND IS NOT TRANSFERABLE.

Immediate notification shall be made to the Police in the following
circumstances:—
A. Change of ownership.
B. Change of editor.
C. Change of address of either editorial or printing offices.
D. Cessation of publication.

In all such cases the certificate shall be forwarded to the Police for
necessary alteration or cancellation.

The certificate shall likewise be submitted to the Police as and when
required by the Commissioner.

Failure to comply with the foregoing requirements may entail cancellation
of registration facilities.

N.B :—The certificate shall be forwarded to the Police for renewal during January
of each year.

杂志与报纸
依据1937年10月21日市政通告第4878号。

PHOTO NEWS (WAR PICTURES) （《摄影新闻》（战争图片））

已于1942年7月6日注册。

据此向注册编辑 I. H. FISCHER 签发本第 F. 165 号注册证书。
（印：...）
S. Got. 代警务处长。
代表警务处长。
（印：...）

本证书仅就 PHOTO NEWS (WAR PICTURES) （《摄影新闻》（战争图片））的出版事宜签发给注册编辑，且不得转让。

在下列情况下，须立即通知警方：—
A. 所有权变更。
B. 编辑变更。
C. 编辑部或印刷所地址变更。
D. 停止出版。

在所有此类情况下，应将证书送交警方，以便进行必要的修改或注销。

当警务处长要求时，亦应将证书提交给警方。

未能遵守上述要求可能导致取消注册资格。

注意：—每年一月期间，应将证书送交警方以办理续期手续。
